verdict.rationale: Scheduling is a fair question for a feature-flag platform, so the axis applies. The pack only shows one-off, point-in-time scheduling: date-based release constraints (`currentTime` with `DATE_AFTER`), scheduled change requests applied at a specific point in time, and automatic milestone progression in release templates. None of these is a recurring job or workflow schedule, so they are adjacent capabilities that earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
